Bid Summary.value: Austin ISD requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops for high school campuses across the district. The procurement includes Lenovo ThinkPad L15 Gen 5 laptops, Lenovo USB-C Universal Docks, and a Lenovo 3-Year Premier Support with Onsite NBD Warranty. Deliverables include the hardware, docks, and a warranty certificate or Affidavit to be presented upon award. Award will be made to the responsible offeror whose proposal conforms to the solicitation and provides the best value to Austin Independent School District, considering technical qualifications and total proposed pricing.
